_comment: Optional Stop hook for auto-commits after every goal-suite run. Enable by renaming to hooks.json or merging into ~/.claude/settings.json. Uses CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR so it only fires in the right repo.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if [ -f .goal-suite/PLAN.md ]; then if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then git add -A && git commit -m "goal-suite: goal checkpoint $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --no-verify || true; fi; fi
